pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: PARAGRAPH WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.2 Guided Writing: Neatness and Legibility (2 Sessions) • Handwriting •
Topic 3.3: Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you improve your writing skills in Arabic?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text
2. write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GUIDED WRITING: PARAGRAPH WRITING
Subject: ARABIC · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing helps you succeed in ARABIC. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: GUIDED WRITING: PARAGRAPH WRITING
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text

What this means
In this part you learn to identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication

What this means
In this part you learn to write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing to a partner. (skill: write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text.
3. Practise this skill: write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you improve your writing skills in Arabic?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text.
5. Be able to: write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
